title: AI Privacy Audit
description: Conduct a systematic audit of your AI tool data practices and implement concrete privacy protections.
tools: All AI tools you currently use
steps: List every AI tool you use regularly
For each tool: find and check the privacy settings (training data opt-out, data retention)
Review your last 30 days of AI conversations — did you share anything you should not have?
Write your personal AI data policy: "I will / will not share [categories] with AI"
Implement all privacy settings you found in step 2
expectedOutput: A personal AI data policy document and all privacy settings opted-out where available.
bonusChallenges: Research your company's AI policy — does one exist? Does it cover the tools you use?
Test running a sensitive discussion on a local AI model instead of cloud
